Title: Improved process server monitoring and reporting

Body.Content:
For disaster recovery of on-premises VMware VMs and physical servers using Azure Site Recovery, you can now monitor and troubleshoot process server issues with improved server health reporting and alerts. 

Read the detailed documentation here.
